node.title: Re: Automatically exiting a file within a block
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: As the others have said, lexical filehandles are closed automatically when they go out of scope. This does not apply to bareword filehandles such as open FILE, ..., these are essentially globals. Note that you can arrange to have other code executed at the end of the current lexical scope via the [mod://End] module, although I haven't seen much code in the wild actually doing so.
